args.subject: PHL label cleanup
args.body:
June,

Notes on the PHL label confusion:

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb. Any record still using the old name refers to the same account.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals". That report needs its label updated to Pellow Home Living.
- Please check other saved reports and digests for the old "Covey & Lark" or "Covey" labels so they match the new name.
- The Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows.
- The Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments.

Thanks,
Bettina Kroll
